contents: Frozen token-run inputs of independent eval v2 and v3 (products, cases, failures, inputs manifest, freeze), groups with the dev/test split, the intermediate files the input spans point to, AU SKU rows, and the AU itemOptions API responses of every AU product in the inputs. Files are byte copies; nothing was regenerated.
not_included: labels (unchanged; in the earlier eval archives), raw AU item JSON and Rakuten HTML (in the earlier eval archives), family runs, v1
purchase_options: Every AU product in these inputs has its itemOptions API response; au_purchase_option_lines cite $.au_product_options_raw in au_product_sku_arrays.jsonl, which embeds that response.
